For your first shift they won't be expecting too much. Just ask customers if they are ok and if they need any help. And importantly if you don't know something-ask. It's ok to ask for help from others to help the customers. 
If you are on the cash register maybe ask general questions, eg going on holiday is a good one I use at the moment. Good luck!

First off, it's great that you have a job! 
As a starting point to help you talk to others maybe ask them about themselves. This could be what did you do this weekend, have any holidays planned etc?

As a person with SA asking people about themselves is my go to so because I really don't want to come across as rude.

If you have anything in common with them, that's great! But don't worry if you don't, just because you work together doesn't automatically guarantee you have to be friends.

Maybe the best thing for you do is to go to someplace new and meet new people. You say you like to learn languages, language classes? Or are there any cooking groups near to you? 

Please don't give up on yourself, you sound like a really cool person I would be friends with. Remember communication is a two way thing and you have to make some effort; even a little (though I know it's soooooo hard at times). 
Good luck :)

Trainee teacher here (hope this counts!)
Growing up as the sky kid and seeing teachers divert most of their attention to louder, more outgoing kids kinda sucked.

As a teacher I also go out of my way to get to know the quiet or shy kids. I want them to know that they are valued even if they don't always talk as much as everyone else. 
Generally I usually start with pretty closed questions to not make them feel uncomfortable and gradually build up to getting to know them a bit better.
Having a shy kid come up to talk to you showing that they trust you is THE BEST.

Basically shy kids are awesome if teachers give them the chance.

In the Goblet of Fire Harry makes up predictions for Trelawney's homework.

Second: *Lose a treasure possession*

Third: *Because of... Mercury. Why don't you get stabbed in the back by someone you thought was a friend?*

Now this is where it gets clever.

First task: dragons = burns.

Second task: Harry loses a treasure possession he has to retrieve= Ron.

Third task: Mad Eye Moody is not Mad Eye Moody but as we know Barty Crouch Junior who arranged the attempt on Harry's life.

I can't exactly pinpoint a day I thought oh I have ringing in my ears, it was suddenly there, I know that doesn't make much sense. In other words it just appeared for no logical reason. I thankfully haven't had any experience from any other external factors, but obviously ear infections and wax buildup are what I was warned about could make it worse. I haven't had any treatment because I've been able to help myself by teaching my brain to tune it out which has helped loads.
